subject: English
passage: Homeowners can help sustain native bee populations by planting wildflower patches in their yards instead of wide expanses of lawn. Some school districts are ______ programs to promote this practice, creating garden plots and nesting habitats on campus grounds to model pollinator-friendly landscaping for surrounding neighborhoods.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer. In this context, 'instituting' means setting up or initiating. The passage indicates that some school districts are creating garden plots and nesting habitats on campus grounds — concrete actions that establish new programs. 'Instituting' precisely captures this idea of launching programs designed to promote pollinator-friendly landscaping.
